task_spec.retrieval_strategy: One aggregate_source_records call uses bounded parallel cross-source execution (at most eight workers) over every parsed qualified execution route, aggregates in stable order, and returns the primary cross-source Bundle; per-source pagination remains sequential. The public 512-item/16-MB Bundle capacity is shared by execution route, typed partial and truncated outcomes remain limitations, and no claim is made that every upstream record was retrieved. MaterialsGalaxy summary is one provider-level execution route; child dataset identities on returned records remain exact provenance and are not separate outcomes.
